movie.title: Wildcat
movie.overview: An ex-black ops team reunite to pull off a desperate heist in order to save the life of their leader’s eight-year-old daughter.

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
Kate Beckinsale's lead character, Ada is about as intimidating as a bag of spinach, in this truly awful, tough girl action flick. 

There is little to like here. An unoriginal story with a dash of casual misandry, meets what could best be described, as an unintentional satire of "Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels". 

Perhaps the only upside, is the actions not wholly bad but it doesn't really make up, for this films deficits, in most other respects.

In summary, yet another hammy girl boss action flick, no one asked for, much less wanted.

reviews.author: AbsoluteTube
reviews.content: Every character in this was brilliant, it could've been a good film if Kate wasn't walking about looking like a duck begging for bread in a park. Really offputting

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When her eight-year-old daughter is kidnapped, an elite ex-black ops commander reunites with her former team to pull off a dangerous heist and save the child within a twelve-hour window.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: An ex-black ops team is forced back into action when their former leader's eight-year-old daughter is abducted by a ruthless crime boss. To satisfy the steep ransom, the operatives must pull off a high-stakes heist against London's most dangerous criminal empire. Navigating lethal streets amidst a citywide riot, the crew has just twelve hours to complete the job and save the young girl's life. The race against time forces the team to confront past conflicts while executing a desperate rescue mission.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Wildcat centers on Ada, a retired black ops operative whose quiet life is shattered when her eight-year-old daughter, Charlotte, is kidnapped by dangerous underworld figures. The abduction stems from debts run up by Ada's reckless brother, leaving Ada with no choice but to assemble her former special forces crew, including her ex-partner Roman. To raise the massive ransom required to free Charlotte, the team devises a risky plan to pull off a daring heist targeting London's most powerful criminal syndicate. As a massive citywide riot erupts across the streets, the chaos provides both cover and deadly obstacles for their covert operation. With a strict twelve-hour deadline ticking down, the team navigates heavy gunfire, deceptive double-crosses, and lethal enemy combatants to execute the theft. Tensions run high among the group as old romantic history and lingering rivalries resurfare amidst the high-octane violence. Balancing brute tactical force with stealth, Ada and her unit must turn their target against the kidnappers to ensure Charlotte's safe return. Ultimately, the team risks everything in an explosive showdown, proving that their loyalty to one another and Ada's daughter is unbreakable.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Wildcat is a pulse-pounding action thriller that follows Ada, a skilled former black ops commander who has traded her military lifestyle for a quiet life raising her eight-year-old daughter, Charlotte. When a powerful crime lord kidnaps Charlotte to settle a dangerous debt, Ada is driven back into the shadow world she left behind. Realizing she cannot save her daughter alone, Ada calls upon her trusted ex-team—an elite unit of tactical specialists, including her formidable ex-partner, Roman. Together, they outline a desperate rescue plan: orchestrating an impossible heist to steal a massive target from London's most feared criminal kingpin to pay the ransom. Set against the chaotic backdrop of a violent citywide riot, the team must navigate lawless streets, heavily armed gangs, and a ticking twelve-hour clock. Blending intense martial arts action, heist strategy, and high-stakes drama, Wildcat follows a group of battle-tested soldiers risking their lives in a perilous race to bring a child home safe.
